subject: Novum evaluation — sync & proposed decision cadence
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@novum.ai>, Rajiv Kumar <rajiv@novum.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Novum evaluation — sync & proposed decision cadence

Hi Sophie / Rajiv — thanks again for a great conversation this morning. Quick recap and a proposed cadence so we stay aligned while you evaluate Redwood for the contact-center summarization pilot. Please reply with any corrections or add names I missed.

Key pain we heard
- High volume of multi-party calls with inconsistent summaries and missed action-items.
- Current solution costs spike at peak-hour concurrency; ops want predictable unit economics.
- Data residency and audit logs are required for compliance reviews.

Goals you shared
- Pilot: 8-week technical pilot to validate summary fidelity & latency under 2s/token.
- Business KPIs: 80% reduction in manual QC time for summaries; cost per call target <$0.45.
- Compliance: SOC2-like evidence and retention controls for PII-sensitive transcripts.

Proposed mutual action plan (draft milestones & owners)
1) Tech kick-off (engineering) — target: 2027-09-06 — Owner: Novum eng (Rajiv) / Redwood eng (Ben)
2) Data & access (security) — target: 2027-09-13 — Owner: Novum security (legal@novum.ai) / Redwood security (Evelyn) — we will provide redacted sample traces and the security checklist (attached).
3) Pilot run (8 weeks) — 2027-09-20 to 2027-11-15 — Owner: Novum product / Redwood CSM
4) Exec review & metrics sign-off — target: 2027-11-22 — Owner: Novum execs / Redwood AE

Decision process you described
- Technical approval by Rajiv and his team for go/no-go after the 2-week integration verification window.
- Procurement + Legal review parallel to pilot, with final commercial approval after pilot metrics are signed off.

Open questions for you
- Can procurement commit to a target legal review completion by 2027-09-20? (helps us plan reserved capacity)
- Which Novum exec(s) should we include in the final metrics review?

Attachments
- novum-mpa-draft.pdf (draft MPA with milestones & SOW bullets)
- security-evidence.zip (Redwood security checklist + example audit log sample)

Next steps
- If that cadence looks right I can: 1) send an updated MPA with the dates above, 2) schedule the 60m tech kick-off for wk of 9/6, and 3) open a HubSpot record and DocuSign draft for signatures.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.inference | M: +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference — inference that scales

> Hi Sophie / Rajiv — thanks again for a great conversation this morning. Quick recap and a proposed cadence so we stay aligned while you evaluate Redwood for the contact-center summarization pilot. Please reply with any corrections or add names I missed.

Thanks Evelyn — this is super helpful and accurate. A few clarifications from our side:
- Priority: summary accuracy > latency for our initial pilot window; we can accept up to 2.5s/token during heavy concurrency for the integration phase.
- Procurement timeline: our procurement partner expects to complete contractual review by 2027-09-27 (we will push for 9/20 but not guaranteed). Legal is looping in Lauren Pierce (legal@novum.ai) and our procurement lead is Mark Chen (mark.chen@novum.ai).
- Exec review: please include our Head of Product (Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@novum.ai>) for the 11/22 sign-off.

We can confirm the tech kick-off week of 9/6. Rajiv will share an internal sample dataset (anonymized) by 09/02. We reviewed the attached MPA draft and have one redline request: add a procurement review milestone with owner & date.

I'll mark the MPA as "draft accepted pending procurement dates" and will coordinate with Mark on the procurement review.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Grant

Thanks Sophie — appreciate the quick clarification. I updated the MPA draft to reflect the procurement review milestone and included the exec reviewer you flagged. Summary of agreed changes and final mutual action plan below (please treat as current working version until we DocuSign).

Finalized mutual action plan (owners & dates)
- Tech kick-off (engineering): 2027-09-06 — Owners: Rajiv (Novum) / Ben (Redwood) — deliverable: integration checklist + test corpus loaded
- Procurement review (legal/procurement): 2027-09-27 — Owners: Mark Chen (Novum) / Redwood Legal ops — deliverable: redline summary & commercial acceptance
- Security & data access validation: 2027-09-13 — Owners: Lauren Pierce (Novum legal) / Evelyn Hart (Redwood) — deliverable: completed evidence pack and retention config
- Pilot run: 2027-09-20 to 2027-11-15 — Owners: Novum product (Aisha) / Redwood CSM — deliverable: pilot metrics dashboard
- Exec metrics review & sign-off: 2027-11-22 — Owners: Aisha Patel (Novum) / Evelyn Hart (Redwood) — deliverable: decision to expand or sunset

Action items I will take today
- Upload updated novum-mpa-draft.pdf to the shared Drive link and open a HubSpot Opportunity (HS-48021).
- Create DocuSign envelope with the MPA and route to Mark (procurement) and Aisha (exec). DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/novum-mpa
- Confirm tech kick-off time slots (I'll propose Tue/Wed AM PST)

Please reply-all to confirm owners and the procurement target date. If Novum confirms 9/27 as procurement completion, we'll plan reserved capacity for the pilot start on 9/20.

Regards,
